verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird publishes jurisdiction-specific startup material for at least two markets. For the UK, its Employee Incentives page offers downloadable factsheets on EMI, Growth Shares, CSOP and SIP. For Germany, it offers a free German Term Sheet Generator for early financing rounds, and the TwoVenture hub gives start-up guidance across the VC life cycle. Missing for 10: evidence of publications on German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE, insight into the depth of the EMI factsheet content, and jurisdiction-specific content within TwoVenture.
